themes.label: Smart global governance of emerging technologies
themes.definition: Call to urgently create global governance frameworks for science and emerging technologies such as AI, balancing benefits and prevention of threats.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for global AI governance frameworks.
themes.exclusion: Exclude mere references to adopted resolutions without a governance call.
themes.boundary_cases: Welcoming the Global Digital Compact as a basis for governance is also AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: we should urgently create smart global governance frameworks with a long-term vision for science and technology, especially emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence

themes.label: Welcoming UN AI resolutions and Compact
themes.definition: Speakers welcome specific UN instruments on AI, such as the Global Digital Compact and General Assembly resolution 78/265 on safe, secure and trustworthy AI.
themes.inclusion: Include references to UN AI resolutions, the Global Digital Compact or Summit of the Future outcomes on AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude governance calls that do not reference a UN instrument.
themes.boundary_cases: Fragmentary passages citing a resolution number still count here.

examples.quote: States to ensure the reliability and security of artificial intelligence (resolution 78/265), in a significant step forward.
I welcome the documents adopted at the Summit for the Future, especially the Global Digital Compact

value.rationale: Both 2024 passages welcome UN instruments on AI (resolution 78/265, Global Digital Compact); Viet Nam additionally calls for smart global governance frameworks for emerging technologies.
